common: Edit this photo. It is a close-up of the face of a real white plush teddy bear toy: long soft pure-white fur, two black glossy bead eyes, a brown felt nose with a thin stitched line under it, a small stitched mouth, the collar of a green knit cardigan at the bottom edge. Keep the picture identical: same framing and zoom, the eyes, nose and mouth exactly in the same places and the same size (do not move, resize, rotate or crop anything), same soft studio light, same pure-white fur colour and texture, same nose, same cardigan. Change only the facial expression, as if the toy came to life, made of its own fur and stitching. Photorealistic plush toy, no cartoon outlines, no blush, no tears, no extra objects. Expression:

faces.name: laugh
faces.text: joyful laughter - both eyes squeezed shut into happy upward arcs (closed eyelids of white fur with a dark lash line, shaped like an upside-down U), the mouth wide open in a big laugh showing the dark inside of the mouth and a pink tongue, cheeks raised high.

faces.name: yawn
faces.text: a big yawn - both eyes squeezed tightly shut with crinkled fur, the mouth opened tall into a big oval O showing the dark inside and a pink tongue at the bottom, the muzzle stretched downward.

faces.name: chew_open
faces.text: chewing with the mouth half open - happy squinting eyes (the fur under the eyes pushes up, the black beads still visible), the mouth slightly open in a small rounded opening showing a pink tongue, cheeks puffed out as if full of food.

faces.name: surprised
faces.text: surprise - the bead eyes wide open, perfectly round, a little larger, with bright highlights, the fur around the eyes lifted, a small round O mouth open showing a pink tongue.

faces.name: eyes_closed
faces.text: calm, gently closed eyes - both eyes closed: eyelids of the same white fur with a thin dark curved lash line where the black beads were, peaceful look; the nose and mouth stay exactly as they are.

faces.name: sad
faces.text: sadness - the inner ends of the brows raised so the fur above each eye slants down toward the outside, heavy upper eyelids of fur cover the top of the bead eyes, the mouth a downturned arc, about to cry.

faces.name: upset
faces.text: pouting and offended like a sulky little child, not angry - heavy eyelids half covering the beads, the lips pressed into a small tight downturned pout pushed slightly to one side.

faces.name: sleepy
faces.text: sleepiness - heavy upper eyelids of white fur cover the upper half of the bead eyes, a drowsy relaxed look, the mouth a small relaxed flat line.

faces.name: chew_closed
faces.text: contentedly chewing with the mouth closed - eyes in a happy squint (the fur under the eyes pushes up, the black beads still visible), the mouth closed in a small cat-like w-shaped smile, cheeks puffed out as if full of food.

faces.name: smile
faces.text: a happy smile - the mouth opens into a small friendly smile showing a little pink tongue, cheeks lifted, the fur under the eyes pushes up a little so the bead eyes look smiling but stay open.

faces.name: laugh2
faces.text: a soft giggle - both eyes closed into happy upward arcs (upside-down U), the mouth open in a medium smile showing a pink tongue, cheeks raised.

faces.name: lick
faces.text: licking the lips after something tasty - blissful squinting eyes, a closed smile, the tip of a pink tongue licking the corner of the upper lip on one side.
